shared_elements: incised/drawn linear marks covering a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces bear humanly made marks on rock including small schematic figures and long lines of repeated signs, but that is about the extent of it: A shows a formal arched stele with a framed relief scene of standing figures flanking a central emblem above dense ordered rows of script, whereas B shows loosely scattered painted outlines (boat-like curved forms, a circle, animal or figure shapes) with no frame, register or hierarchical composition. The specific compositional scheme of A (symmetrical flanking figures under a winged disc above a text block) has no counterpart in B, so shared content is only the generic fact of marked rock with schematic figures.
